SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TNKM.APKIHONCD APKIHONCD, SHMV.SHOPCD SHOPCD, SHMV.SHNCD SHNCD, TNKM.STSHNCD STSHNCD, TNKM.RENBAN RENBAN, TNKM.KOSEISHNAPKIHONCD KOSEISHNAPKIHONCD, TNKM.KOSEISHNCD KOSEISHNCD, TNKM.KEIJOKBN KEIJOKBN, CASE WHEN SHMV.SHNNMKIRIKAEDD <= #{unyodate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN SHMV.SHINSHNNM ELSE SHMV.GENZSHNNM END SHNNM, CASE WHEN SHMV.HYOJUNPRICEKIRIKAEDD <= #{unyodate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN SHINPRICEKBN ELSE GENZPRICEKBN END PRICEKBN, CASE WHEN SHMV.HYOJUNPRICEKIRIKAEDD <= #{unyodate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN SHINPRICEKBNNM.ITEMNM ELSE GENZPRICEKBNNM.ITEMNM END PRICEKBNNM, CASE WHEN SHMV.HYOJUNPRICEKIRIKAEDD <= #{unyodate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN SHMV.SHINHYOJUNPRICE ELSE SHMV.GENZHYOJUNPRICE END DLVRYHYOJUNPRICE, CASE WHEN SHMV.HYOJUNPRICEKIRIKAEDD <= #{unyodate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN SHMV.SHINMOCHIKAERIPRICE ELSE SHMV.GENZMOCHIKAERIPRICE END MOCHIKAERIHYOJUNPRICE, TNKM.DLVRYPRICE DLVRYHANBAIPRICE, TNKM.MOCHIKAERIPRICE MOCHIKAERIHANBAIPRICE, SHMV.SHNAPKIHONCD SHNAPKIHONCD, TNKM.SURYO SURYO, SHMV.URIIRISU URIIRISU, SYKM.MOJISETTEIATAI URITANINM, SHMV.SHOPYUKOKBN, SHMV.TRTSKIKBN, SHMV.STKBN, SHMV.SURYOHASUKANRIKBN, TNKM.KSHNSYSTMYMD KSHNSYSTMYMD, TNKM.KSHNSYSTMJIKAN KSHNSYSTMJIKAN FROM S02M008T TNKM LEFT JOIN S02V001T SHMV ON ( SHMV.SHNAPKIHONCD = TNKM.KOSEISHNAPKIHONCD AND SHMV.SHNCD = TNKM.KOSEISHNCD AND SHMV.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SHMV.SHOPCD = #{shopcd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) LEFT JOIN S02M006T SYKM ON ( SYKM.APKIHONCD = '000' AND SYKM.SHOPCD = '000' AND SYKM.SETTEINO = '013' AND SYKM.RCRDKBN = 'M' AND SYKM.SETTEICD = SHMV.URITANI ) LEFT JOIN S01M004T GENZPRICEKBNNM ON ( GENZPRICEKBNNM.CONDITIONID = 'CN028' AND GENZPRICEKBNNM.SETTEIATAI = SHMV.GENZPRICEKBN ) LEFT JOIN S01M004T SHINPRICEKBNNM ON ( SHINPRICEKBNNM.CONDITIONID = 'CN028' AND SHINPRICEKBNNM.SETTEIATAI = SHMV.SHINPRICEKBN ) WHERE TNKM.APKIHONCD = #{shnapkihoncd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TNKM.STSHNCD = #{stshncd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{rownum} + 1

SELECT TNKM.APKIHONCD, TNKM.STSHNCD, TNKM.RENBAN, TNKM.KOSEISHNAPKIHONCD, TNKM.KOSEISHNCD, TNKM.KEIJOKBN, TNKM.SURYO, TNKM.DLVRYPRICE, TNKM.MOCHIKAERIPRICE, SHMV.LCTGRYCD, SHMV.MCTGRYCD, SHMV.SCTGRYCD, SHMV.HYOJUNPRICEKIRIKAEDD, SHMV.GENZHYOJUNPRICE, SHMV.SHINHYOJUNPRICE, SHMV.GENZMOCHIKAERIPRICE, SHMV.SHINMOCHIKAERIPRICE, SHMV.TAXSETTEIKBN, SHMV.TAXKBN FROM S02M008T TNKM INNER JOIN S02V001T SHMV ON( SHMV.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SHMV.SHOPCD = #{shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SHMV.SHNAPKIHONCD = TNKM.APKIHONCD AND SHMV.SHNCD = TNKM.STSHNCD AND SHMV.SHOPYUKOKBN = '1') WHERE TNKM.STSHNCD = #{stshncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TNKM.YUKOKBN = '1' ORDER BY TNKM.RENBAN

SELECT TKM.RENBAN ,TKM.KOSEISHNCD AS SHNCD ,SMV.GENZSHNNM ,SMV.SHINSHNNM ,SMV.SHNNMKIRIKAEDD ,SKM1.MOJISETTEIATAI AS KEIJOKBNNM ,TKM.DLVRYPRICE AS TKDLVRYPRICE ,TKM.MOCHIKAERIPRICE AS TKMOCHIKAERIPRICE
